text: In the diffractive layer model U^{l+1} = H_d * diag(t^l) * U^l, which part is learned and which is fixed by physics?
choices: Only the diagonal transmission diag(t^l) is trained; the propagation/connectivity operator H_d is fixed by physics
Only H_d is trained; the transmission diag(t^l) is fixed
Both H_d and the transmission are trained jointly
Neither is trained; the whole network is random
explanation: A diffractive layer is a fixed dense off-diagonal connectivity H_d (the diffraction integral) times a trained diagonal transmission diag(t^l); only the diagonal (the pixel phases) is learned, while H_d is set by geometry and wavelength. The connectivity is supplied for free, so training it is neither possible nor necessary.
